normal_motion_clock_gate: Both motion and monotonic-wall exposure age <= 0.25 s; missing/failed independent recorded-clock audit prevents whole-task success in final statistics
sensing_rescan_budget: At most six accepted rescan proposals per observed object, including incoming handover; no same-task reset; maximum eight object cycles; all modes use the same rule
postprocessing: Independent geometry and wrench audits per trial, retained raw-clock audits, final-state broad/local surface and unsafe-free probes, then scene-paired statistics; commissioning failures remain failures
scene_admission: None; generation, commissioning and execution failures remain in denominator
sample_size_rationale: 24 independent scenes for a bounded simulation feasibility and paired-effect estimation study, not a powered superiority test. A perfect 24/24 rate still has a 95% Wilson lower limit near 0.862; wide intervals and discordant outcomes must be retained.
policy_order: Cyclic rotation by scene seed modulo number of policies
resampling_unit: scene, not frame or control tick
failed_trial_cost: Never assign zero full-task cost; common-success conditional effects and all-attempt failures reported separately
source_rule: Freeze before the batch; no tuning or code changes during the batch. Any later algorithm tuning makes these scenes development data, requiring a new holdout allocation.
